original_query: SELECT sal, SUM(comm), MIN(comm), SUM(DISTINCT sal) FROM emp GROUP BY sal
rewritten_query: SELECT sal, SUM(comm), MIN(comm), sal AS sum_distinct_sal FROM emp GROUP BY sal

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace SUM(DISTINCT sal) with sal: since sal is the GROUP BY key, all rows in each group share the same sal value (or NULL). SUM(DISTINCT sal) therefore always equals sal (NULL for the NULL group), making the DISTINCT aggregate redundant. Removing it eliminates the distinct-aggregation overhead and allows the planner to choose a HashAggregate instead of Sort + GroupAggregate on 45M rows.
No additional predicate simplification possible — the query has no WHERE/JOIN filters; it is a full-table aggregation.
No subqueries or CTEs present; creating a CTE would add overhead with no benefit for this single-pass aggregation.
